pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Ruined Citadel.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: The Ender Guardian is found in the Ruined Citadel. Create distance and leave the frontal sector when it prepares a wide strike. Breaking its helmet changes the boss’s state; do not assume that its defenses stay identical throughout the fight.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: Direct arrow hits are rejected while the helmet is intact. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Gauntlet of Guard, Music Disc. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.
